name: pyrithione zinc
uses: Uses Helps prevent and control recurrence of itching, flaking, redness and irritation associated with dandruff
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only When using this product avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop and ask a doctor if condition worsens or does not improve after regular use of this product as desired. Keep this and all drugs out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
